title: Duplicate payment policy
body: Duplicate payments inside seven days must be held for review. The controller must verify vendor, invoice number, payment reference, and bank account before release.

title: PO policy
body: Invoices without purchase orders require a document request before payment. Finance analysts may request documentation, but controllers approve payment release.

title: Bank account change policy
body: Changed vendor bank accounts are high risk. Any bank account mismatch must be escalated to the controller and cannot be auto-approved.

title: Unmatched invoice policy
body: Invoices without confident payment matches must be held for review before month-end close. Finance should verify payment evidence and customer follow-up status.

title: Overdue invoice policy
body: Overdue unpaid invoices require customer follow-up and aging review before month-end close. Finance should send a follow-up before escalating.

title: Ledger reconciliation policy
body: Unmatched ledger entries must be investigated before close and tied back to invoice and payment evidence.
